notes.title: The Mystic is here.
notes.content:
[h2]The mystic is releasing out of early access![/h2]

Along with the release we are launching our the biggest update yet. Adding many fixes along with the full Campaign. We are also planning to add more bugfixes in the future (current patch notes down below).

We wan to thank many players that played the game in EA and submitted vital feedback. Without you it would be much harder. I also want to thank many colleagues that worked on the game and helped to make it better.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1 (Major improvments to AI)
notes.content:
[h1]Greatings! Fellow pilgrims.[/h1]
 
We worked hard and long to give you the first taste of new AI. While our work is not yet finished there are many improvements.
 
Enhanced Ai is a completely new adaptive algorithm which reacts on players´ and other AIs´ actions with both randomness and hardwired behaviour. What is new then?
 
[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
Better reaction on handicaps or advantages.
 
[h3]Basic exploration and looting[/h3]
Units now have roles and one of them is to be an explorer which means to effectively explore maps or reveal POI (points of interest, like loot) even provoke enemies.
 
[h3]Map awareness[/h3]
AI now better reacts to situations on the map. Visited and visible hex tiles now generate POI to various heatmaps and by the unit role, AI prepares and sends units there to collect more data or take action.
 
[h3]Hex tile reservation system[/h3]
Moving units around the map is not that complicated when you know the destination. Tile is reserved and AI will try to move units to neighbour hex tile if needed. Units are moved constantly moving in to even formations. Only a few scenarios will make the unit not to move.
 
[h3]Starting mode, behaviour, modding[/h3]
AI can start in "starting profile" to boost economics. We added simple mudding options to drive AI behaviour by setting or clearing flags in the local file (in folder TheMysticEditor/mods) or in game by using build-in console (tilde or semicolon, the key under ESC) commands. Try to write "help" there to check syntax.
 
[h3]Aggressive and economic modes[/h3]
Mystic is a dynamic game and new AI is more dynamic too. Primary is set up in building things and expanding. But when time is right, you will know the AI switched profile to be more challenging.
 
[h3]Coordinated attack[/h3]
Time to time AI forms attack formation to try to eradicate you. Attacks are far from be the best (as whole AI) but it adds more dynamics and tension to game experience.
 
[h3]Battle simulation[/h3]
Everything has a cost and AI knows it. Is it worth to go to battle with this unit, or should I retreat? Every movement is predated by calculations which tile to move is the best.
 
[h3]Advanced active defence[/h3]
The most complicated new thing in AI is active defence. AI checks for threats, their level and who is causing it. If parameters are right AI will send the best unit for the job - defending the area whether it is an outlier farm or heart of your city. AI even tries to be present near buildings until released from that duty. Player attack should be more challenging than ever.
 
[h3]Spell management, terraforming[/h3]
Spells are a key mechanic of the game so is the terraforming. AI tries to have the most efficient income. Targets  terraforming spells near the area as it needs to. or cast an attack spell on  to nearby enemy units - again calculating the best possible tile to cast a spell. When a spell is not needed or cannot be casted few turns, it dismisses it and charges up a new spell better - suited for the situation.
 
 
[h2]What next [/h2]
Unique behaviour for all factions.
More difficulty dynamics.
Mechanism for long promised Campaign.
All spells.
Polishing parameters.
Improvements in the late game. Currently AI starts to be less effective around Tier 4.
 
 
In the meantime we discovered lots of bugs from our testing and your feedback. (variant in sizes and severity) - clearing them in process. Added some new small changes to keep the game crash-free and better optimized.
 
[h3]Have a great time.[/h3]

notes.title: Content patch 0.4.0
notes.content:
Hi Everybody 

Our second content patch is here. Patch is bringing 3 more unique factions to the game as well as many late game spells. (for detailed patch notes please look in to the game or on our wiki)

These factions represent three human goods. You can play as these in custom games. Each of them is equipped with own Magic land and 4 unique units. As well as several spells to specialize faction gameplay and experience. 

There have been some improvements done to unit visuals and fixes to animations. Also, big improvement to unit formations on tiles was made.

Patch also includes many bugfixes and improvements to various systems/mechanics based on your feedback. If you find more let us know via in reporting in-game tool or here on steam page. We will add them to the list (known issues) and fix them as soon as possible.

In meanwhile we are preparing next big patch that should include major improvements of AI. As well as many other bugfixes.
Thank you for your support.
PS: we uncovered save game issue that plagued us for some time. It will be fixed in next mini patch somewhere in next week.

notes.title: Early access relese
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38868465/d542cd5479bf8c1a484f9b1a7f98b0e10841fd6a.png[/img][h1][b]Early access Release [/b][/h1]

[b]Why and what is the goal of early release [/b]
Hi everybody! We are as of 10.11.2020 releasing Mystic in an Early Access. We were planning to release the game in to full distribution sometime next year. However, due to the recent complications caused by COVID-19 we are forced to release it early. Goals of this release are as follows.

- Get game to players and gather feedback for better bug fixing.
- Improve marketing. So far, we have been preparing for the release later on so this change throws proverbial spanner in the works.

[b]Current Game features[/b]
Currently implemented features
- tutorial 
- skirmish on randomly generated map. Against AI or human player.
- multiplayer with or against human players through LAN   
- map and campaign editors
- 5 factions 
- around 20 spells
- 9 units 

[b]Upcoming game features[/b]
features we are working on.
- story campaign
- improved AI
- 29 units 
- bug fixing of all 51 spells
- spying system 
- improving editors
- integrating more steam functions

[b]Bugs [/b]
As well as adding features, we are currently working on bug fixing the game. You can help us with that by reporting them directly in the game (if it is not working check your firewall setting), here on Steam or on our discord server. 

https://discord.gg/4RcBPdp

Support us in this endeavour by [b]buying or wishlisting [/b] the game. If for some reason you chose not to, support other small indie devs instead! I guarantee they will appreciate it in these trying times. 

Have a nice day.
PS: Sorry for my grammar. English is not my primary language.
PS:: We recently posted miniupdate. fixing most mentioned bugs including failed load of tutorial and text size and wrong placemnt problems.
